chronicle.text: Thuboun tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Voukus tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Lahoul tied flint and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Theimaim struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Theimaim tied a blade and wood together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
Yavok tied a club and a club together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
Years 0-24: population 20 to 3, 17 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (11), thirst (11), neglect (10). Average happiness 0.67. Recorded: 6 inventions, 21 firsts, 10 band changes.
Years 25-49: population 3 to 1, 0 births. Deaths mostly from illness (2). Average happiness 0.60. Recorded: 1 firsts.
